name: refresh
description: Refresh now: re-run dt against Delta (shop/world) for Sergey's open PRs — authored by him, plus River-authored PRs assigned to him — (checks, merge readiness, reviews, mergeability and Merge Garden comments per PR) and PRs requesting his review, persist the result, and return lane counts (a PR in Blocked and Waiting on review counts in both). Takes ~10-40 s. Throws with the failure message if the refresh fails (previous data is kept).

name: list_prs
description: List tracked PRs from the last refresh (does not call Delta). With `group`, returns that lane's rows; without it, returns every lane. Sergey's own PRs (authored, or River-authored and assigned to him; ownership author|assigned): merging (Merge Garden accepted /merge and the PR is in flight: waiting for CI or in the merge queue), ready_to_merge (human-approved, nothing blocking, nothing pending; Required CI not run yet is fine because /merge runs it), blocked (anything that stops it getting through: merge conflict incl. as of last pull, failing CI/checks, open Binks findings, a current Merge Garden stop, unresolved threads, another merge-readiness blocker or an older human change request), ci_pending (human-approved, nothing blocking, but a required check/status has not run yet or is still running, e.g. CI running, Binks reviewing; pending is never a block, and Blocked wins over it), waiting_on_review (no counting human approval, or a newer human change request), draft. Every PR is in exactly one lane, except an unapproved PR with a blocker, which is in both blocked and waiting_on_review (its lanes field lists both; group is blocked). waiting_on_my_review: PRs requesting his review. Each row has number, title, url, group (primary lane), lanes, status (the Blocked: part names every blocking reason), author, ownership, updatedAt (last update on Delta). Rows with a /merge posted from the widget since the last refresh are listed under merging with mergeRequestedAt set. Each row also has projects (names of the registered Cake projects that own it, from Delta zone labels, changed paths or title prefix; null when unknown) and fixRequestedAt (when a Fix from the widget was sent to its Project Chat and is still held).

name: summary
description: One-line summary of Sergey's Delta PRs from the last pull: counts per lane (merging, ready_to_merge, blocked, ci_pending, waiting_on_review, draft, waiting_on_my_review; a PR both blocked and waiting on review counts in both and the text says how many), data age in minutes, last error, and the 5 most recent refresh runs (source schedule/view/agent, ok, duration).

name: get_pr
description: Full tracked detail for one PR number from the last refresh: group (primary lane) and lanes, status, review verdict (approved/changes_requested/needs_approval/unknown), counting human approvers (approvedBy), ignored approvals with reasons (bot, dismissed, not counted by Delta), plain-words merge blockers (blockedBy), every reason it is Blocked (blockReasons), checks not run yet / still running (pending), Merge Garden state (merge: merging/stopped/requested/cancelled with phase or reason), ownership (author/assigned) and authorBrand, Binks state/findings, failing checks, CI, unresolved threads, raw merge blockers. Also projects/projectSource (which registered Cake projects own it and how that was found) and, for Blocked rows, fixReason and fixKey.

name: open_pr
description: Open https://delta.shopify.io/shop/world/pull/<number> in the default browser on Sergey's Mac (used by the widget's row links, since the widget sandbox blocks pop-ups).

name: merge_pr
description: Post exactly the comment "/merge" on one of Sergey's PRs in Delta (as his dt identity), which asks Merge Garden to merge it. Only allowed for a tracked PR currently in Ready to merge, without a pending /merge. Nothing else is done (no approval, CI trigger or rebase). On success the PR shows as Merging (requested) until the next refresh resolves its real state. Throws without posting when not allowed; throws when the post fails.

name: request_fix
description: Ask the owning project's Project Chat to fix tracked PRs in Blocked (the widget's Fix and Fix all buttons). Sends one artifact-attributed chat message per project (Cake chat.prompt) listing each PR's number, title, Delta link, group and concrete reason (blockers, Binks finding count, failing checks, Merge Garden stop, unresolved threads). Posts nothing to Delta. Duplicate numbers are sent once (a PR in Blocked and Waiting on review is one PR). A PR goes to the project at projectPath when it belongs to it, else to its primary project. A PR is skipped (not sent again) while an earlier Fix is held: until its group, head commit, blockers, failing checks, Binks findings, Merge Garden stop or unresolved threads change, or 120 minutes pass. Returns per-PR outcomes; a failed send records nothing.

projectPath.description: The registered project the view is scoped to (the chat being looked at).

source.description: row/fix_all: Sergey clicked Fix/Fix all in the widget. agent (default): an agent called this tool; the message says so.
